about.text: Baked milk is a variety of boiled milk that has been particularly popular in Russia, Ukraine and Belarus. It is made by simmering milk on low heat for eight hours or longer.

facts.v: Simmered on low heat for 8 h or more, or boiled milk left in a Russian stove for a day or overnight until coated with a brown crust
Lactose and amino acids react (Maillard) to melanoidins, giving the cream colour and caramel taste
